column1: # Deliberate divergences from the Ceph s3compat expectation.
# NOT loaded by default. `tools/g5-score.py` only counts these when you pass
# --divergences, because accepting one is an owner decision, not a measurement.
# Unlike the generated policy, entries here are Rust-only failures: the Python
# Swift oracle passes them. They are listed because the engine deliberately
# chose a different behavior, and every entry must name the document that
# justifies it so the choice stays auditable.
# Governance bypass requires the header AND an explicit IAM Allow. AWS, RGW and
# Python Swift all permit the resource owner implicitly; this engine does not,
# on purpose, and two unit tests pin it. Accepted as a divergence rather than
# reversed. Option B (owner-implicit bypass) stays open as engine work and
# should land on a candidate that has a G0 identity from the start.
